items.calibration: melting points of highly pure indium and aluminum
items.quote: In order to choose the most reliable set of data among the results available in the literature, some further DTA experiments were carried out in alumina crucibles. The Pd-Se samples were prepared by heating ingots of selenium (99.999%) and palladium powder (99.95%), both supplied by Goodfellow. For each experiment, a prior thermal treatment was performed to homogenize the Pd-Se composition. The DTA (Setsys - Setaram) was calibrated on the melting points of highly pure indium and aluminum. The DTA curves were processed according to NIST recommended guide on differential thermal analysis and heat-flux differential scanning calorimetry dedicated to melting and solidification of metals and alloys [19]. Due to supercooling phenomena, the DTA responses were measured on heating and the uncertainty of the measurements were estimated to be ±2 K.
